name: Gareth Llewellyn
bio:
Gareth's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. After years managing supply chains for a quarry in North Wales, a chance encounter with a local rally team revealed a knack for efficient logistics in a high-pressure environment. He quickly adapted, bringing his organizational skills and problem-solving abilities to the track. Gareth is now a key logistics coordinator at Rahal Letterman Lanigan, where he meticulously plans the transportation and maintenance schedules for the team's equipment and personnel, ensuring everything arrives at the right place, at the right time.

Gareth's pragmatic approach to logistics is his hallmark. He's not one for flashy solutions or unnecessary innovation; instead, he focuses on proven methods and meticulous planning. This reliability, combined with his loyalty to the team, has earned him the respect of his colleagues. Gareth also has a knack for anticipating potential problems, often devising creative solutions to avoid disruptions before they even occur. 

His experience is invaluable to the team, and his dedication ensures the smooth operation of race weekends.

physical.description: Gareth is a stocky man with a weathered face and kind eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small, worn notebook filled with handwritten schedules and notes.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on drinking his tea from a specific chipped mug he's had for years.
